summary_en: Annual dividend raised to ¥22.00/share from ¥20.00 prior estimate. Year-end dividend revised to ¥11.00/share (¥10.00 ordinary + ¥1.00 commemorative) from ¥10.00 prior estimate; interim dividend raised to ¥11.00/share from ¥10.00 prior estimate. Commemorative dividend of ¥2.00/share total (¥1.00 interim + ¥1.00 year-end) marks company's 75th anniversary.
title_en: Notification regarding revision of H2 (interim) and full-year earnings forecasts for fiscal year ending December 2026, and revision of year-end dividend forecast (implementation of commemorative dividend)
translation_en_brief: On 31 July 2026, Takahashi Curtain Wall Corporation announced revisions to its earnings forecasts for fiscal year ending 31 December 2026 and modifications to its dividend policy. The company raised its full-year dividend forecast to ¥22.00 per share from the prior estimate of ¥20.00 per share. The revision comprises: interim dividend increased to ¥11.00/share from ¥10.00/share (decided at board meeting on the disclosure date); year-end dividend raised to ¥11.00/share from ¥10.00/share prior estimate, split between ordinary dividend of ¥10.00 and a commemorative dividend of ¥1.00. The ¥2.00 total commemorative dividend (¥1.00 interim + ¥1.00 year-end) marks the company's 75th anniversary. The board determined the interim dividend on the disclosure date; the year-end dividend revision reflects both improved earnings performance (operating profit revised upward 62.2%, ordinary income up 56.6%, attributable net income up 58.5%) and the anniversary milestone. The company states it aims to balance stable dividend payouts with investment in future growth and internal reserves.
